description: HesabYar Phase 0 (per design-eng.md §17): architecture lock + technical spikes. ADR 0002 assigns the canonical ledger to Tryton 8.2; local Tryton+PostgreSQL test environment; REST adapter spike proving accounts read + journal draft create/validate with no direct SQL; IRR precision + Jalali mapping verified; Sao workflows inventoried as a UI blueprint. Spec: ~/workspace/user/files/design-eng_0_zaup.md. Exit criteria: a tested adapter spike can read accounts and create/validate a journal draft without direct database access.

acceptanceCriteria: docs/adr/0002-tryton-as-accounting-engine.md exists with context, decision, consequences and the rules from design-eng §1.1 (Tryton is the default accounting engine; HesabYar exposes AccountingEnginePort + Tryton adapter; no duplicate journal-entry tables in the default deployment; native ledger mutually exclusive per installation; the same financial event is never posted into both engines)
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md updated to version 1.5.0 with the same rules; the frozen 1.4.0 native-ledger R0 goal is explicitly superseded, not silently contradicted
README.md and other docs no longer claim a native HesabYar general ledger as the production design (grep clean for the contradiction)
Ruff and Pyright pass
userStories.description: As the project owner I want the Tryton-as-engine decision recorded and the frozen architecture updated, so implementation has one unambiguous authority and no competing ledger is built.
userStories.notes: PASS 2026-11-16. Commit dfcb087: ADR 0002 created (all §1.1 rules), ARCHITECTURE.md 1.5.0 with explicit 1.4.0 supersession, CONTEXT.md + CURRENT_RULES_1405.md targeted fixes; README had no ledger claim (grep-verified, untouched). Ruff + Pyright pass (0 errors). Verified by coordinator from commit + grep.
userStories.title: ADR 0002 + architecture 1.5.0 (Tryton owns the ledger)

acceptanceCriteria: Sao reference cloned to a SEPARATE research directory OUTSIDE the repo (~/workspace/projects/hesabyar-reference/sao), never inside src/ or the app

docs/research/sao-inventory.md inventories navigation, forms, list views, action flows, wizards, filters, report actions and permissions, and maps the needed functions to the dashboard modules in design-eng §18
License manifest records tryton-sao 6.7.0, GPL-3.0+, archived-mirror status, and the rule that no Sao source is copied into the app without a separate GPL compliance decision
Grep confirms no Sao source code exists under src/ or apps/
Ruff and Pyright pass
userStories.description: As the frontend designer I want an inventory of Sao's workflows and a license record, so the new Next.js dashboard rebuilds the right flows without copying GPL code.
userStories.notes: PASS 2026-11-16. Commit 9b97a61: Sao cloned outside repo at ~/workspace/projects/hesabyar-reference/sao (HEAD 8eb1e9c, 2022-12-10); docs/research/sao-inventory.md (501 lines, source-inspected, §18 mapping incl. no-counterpart modules 8/9/10/11) + sao-license.md (tryton-sao 6.7.0, GPL-3.0+, archived mirror, no-copy rule). Ruff + Pyright pass; grep confirms no Sao code under src/ (no apps/ dir). Caveat: inventory is a 6.7.0 baseline; details to re-check against live 8.2 server. Verified by coordinator from commit + clone metadata + grep.
userStories.title: Sao workflow inventory + license manifest

acceptanceCriteria: PostgreSQL installed and running locally (no Docker in this VM — native install); HesabYar test database reachable with the URL the repo tests expect

Tryton 8.2 series installed with the EXACT pinned release recorded; module set installed: account, account_invoice, account_payment, account_statement, account_asset, analytic accounting, company, currency, party, product (no manufacturing/CRM/HR/warehouse/POS)
A clean Tryton test database is initialized (trytond-admin) and the trytond server starts and answers
Setup is documented in docs/dev-setup.md (install steps, pinned versions, how to start/stop, how to reset the test DB)
Full test suite is green including the 15 PostgreSQL tests that error without a database
Ruff and Pyright pass
userStories.description: As a developer I want a reproducible local Tryton 8.2 + PostgreSQL test environment, so adapter work and contract tests run against a real server.
userStories.notes: PASS 2026-11-16. Commit 44bd228 (docs/dev-setup.md, 310 lines). PostgreSQL 16.15 native (cluster 16 main, port 5432); DBs hesabyar_test + hesabyar_tryton_test (separate, spec §7.1). Tryton 8.2.3 pinned (PyPI-verified; analytic module = analytic_account) in isolated venv hesabyar-reference/tryton-env/; 10 modules + transitive deps only; REST app key hesabyar-dev-rest-key provisioned. Full suite 160 passed (coordinator re-ran). Caveats: /etc/hosts is read-only squashfs → HESABYAR_DATABASE_URL env-var approach documented; naiad has no stable PyPI release (1.0.dev only) — US-003 must decide client approach; 8.2 API notes (JSON-RPC /rpc/, Session header, trailing {} context, Bearer app key for REST) in dev-setup.md. Server stopped at handoff; PostgreSQL running.
userStories.title: Local Tryton 8.2 + PostgreSQL test environment

acceptanceCriteria: Engine-neutral AccountingEnginePort protocol exists in the domain layer (no Tryton imports in domain code)

TrytonAccountingAdapter under src/hesabyar/infrastructure/accounting/tryton/ (client, adapter, mapping, errors) talks to Tryton ONLY through the supported REST API (naiad / docs.tryton.org/8.2/client-rest); no SQL against Tryton's database anywhere (grep-enforced)
Contract test against the live test DB reads the chart of accounts for a company
Contract test against the live test DB creates a journal draft and validates it (balanced debit/credit, valid accounts, open period)
Tryton errors are translated to stable HesabYar application errors without leaking stack traces
Ruff, Pyright and the full test suite pass
userStories.description: As the platform I want a working Tryton adapter spike, so Phase 0 proves the REST integration before any UI or workflow is built on it.
userStories.notes: PASS 2026-11-16. Commit 43da646 (18 files, +2729): domain/accounting/ (refs, value_objects, commands, AccountingEnginePort — no Tryton/httpx/SQLAlchemy imports), infrastructure/accounting/tryton/ (client, adapter, mapping, errors, contracts — REST only, no SQL/JSON-RPC, grep + unit-test enforced). Naiad decision: direct httpx, no naiad (only 1.0.dev exists, personal repo, not tryton.org). Test company 'HesabYar Adapter Test' id 2, 135-account chart via create_chart wizard path, FY 2026 + 12 open periods. 9 contract + 32 unit tests. trust_env=False fix confirmed in client (proxy env bug). Port is sync, create+validate only; post/reverse/report deferred. Coordinator re-verified: full suite 250 passed server-up, 213 passed + 37 skipped server-down, ruff clean, pyright 0 errors.
userStories.title: Tryton REST adapter spike (accounts + journal draft)

acceptanceCriteria: IRR currency is configured in the Tryton test DB with zero decimal digits; a contract test posts/reads large integer IRR amounts with zero precision loss
Fractional Rial values are rejected by the adapter (never silently rounded to Toman)
FiscalDate Jalali-to-Gregorian mapping is verified against Tryton date fields with round-trip tests (including digit normalization)
Results are documented (currency config + test evidence) in docs/dev-setup.md or the adapter docs
Ruff, Pyright and the full test suite pass
userStories.description: As the accounting owner I want IRR precision and Jalali dates proven against real Tryton behavior, so no amount or date is ever silently corrupted.
userStories.notes: PASS 2026-11-16. Commit 3290af6 (49 tests in tests/infrastructure/test_tryton_irr_jalali.py, 849 lines; dev-setup.md §7). IRR currency id 1 digits=0 via REST (coordinator re-verified live: digits 0, rounding Decimal 1, code IRR, numeric_code 364); large-integer round-trips bit-exact up to 19 digits; 12 live FiscalDate cases incl. Persian/Arabic-Indic digits + leap edges; fractional-Rial rejection verified at transport/mapping/command/port levels via the real US-003 adapter (after its commit 43da646). Company 'HesabYar IRR Test' id 3. Coordinator re-verified: 58 contract tests passed (9 adapter + 49 IRR/Jalali), full suite 250 passed server-up.
userStories.title: IRR precision + Jalali mapping verification
